jobs.title: Physics Tutor in Tulsa
jobs.description:
BuffTutor is a network of experienced and passionate tutors who provide academic assistance to college & high school students. We are always hiring dedicated tutors; if you love teaching, join us!
RESPONSIBILITIES:

•
Provide 1-on-1 in-person tutoring to students attending universities or high schools in Tulsa such as University of Tulsa.

•
Provide online tutoring to students located throughout the country (if desired).

•
Assist students with Physics topics

• Classical mechanics: Kinematics, dynamics, forces, momentum, energy
,• Thermodynamics: Heat, temperature, ideal gases, laws of thermodynamics
,• Electricity and magnetism: Charges, fields, potential, circuits, induction
,• Waves and optics: Wave characteristics, sound, geometric/physical optics
,• Relativity and modern physics: Time dilation, length contraction, quantum basics
,• Nuclear physics: Radioactivity, fission, fusion, and atomic structures

BENEFITS:
• Set your own rate.
• In-person & online tutoring available; meet wherever works for you.
• Set your own schedule; meet whenever works for you.
• Work with as many (or as few) students as you would like to.

QUALIFICATIONS:
• Have at least a 3.0 or better major GPA (out of 4.0).
• Have earned a B or better in the courses you wish to tutor.
• Have at least one year (or two semesters) of experience as a tutor, teacher, teaching/learning assistant or instructor.
• Have excellent communication skills and you must be fluent in the language that you teach in. Foreign Language tutors must be fluent in the Foreign Language they wish to tutor.

ABOUT BUFFTUTOR:
BuffTutor is dedicated to connecting students with intelligent and experienced tutors. We primarily focus on university level tutoring, but also work with high school and middle school students. More than just another tutor list, we prioritize the academic needs of our students while also treating our tutors with dignity and respect:
• We have some of the strictest eligibility criteria and challenging proficiency exams. Only the best can join our network!
• Tutors can set their own schedule. Our motto is quality is more important than quantity. Take on one student but be the best tutor for that student!
• Tutors can set their own rate. Earn what you are worth!
• We review student evaluations to help us keep the best tutor in our network.
BuffTutor was founded in 2009 and since then we have helped thousands of students and parents connect with affordable and passionate educators!
Please note that tutors are independent contractors, not employees. All applicants must already have work permissions; applicants who are students must be able to work an off-campus position. We do not sponsor individuals and we cannot work with F-1 or J-1 international students

jobs.title: Medical Physicist
jobs.description:
All client facilities use CMS Monaco for treatment planning, Mosaiq’s R&V system and Elekta linacs to deliver treatment; each site can sim patients and is attached to a full medical oncology suite.

The main campus offers additional treatment options including nuclear medicine, a full imaging suite, an HDR suite and Precision treatment planning for Tomotherapy.

5 linear accelerators are housed at the main campus, including 2 Tomotherapy units, 3 Elekta units (1 Infinity, 2 Versa HD (SRS/SBRT capable)) and a dedicated HDR suite utilizing Flexitron and Oncentra planning.

The successful applicant will join a team consisting of 4 radiation oncologists, 7 dosimetrists, 3 physicists, 1 medical physics assistant and 22 therapists. The department adopts new technology readily and listens to great ideas no matter what their origin. If you want to work where your efforts make a difference in how patients receive treatment, this is the place for you.

Experience with technology in our clinics, while helpful, is not explicitly required. The team can train any qualified physicist to utilize all software and equipment.

Qualifications:

-Candidates should possess at least a master’s degree in physics or medical physics from an accredited university and graduated from CAMPEP medical physics residency program.

-A minimum of 2 years’ clinical experience (including residency training time), ABR board eligible is required.

Offer an excellent Benefits Package which includes medical, dental, vision, 401k, paid time off (PTO) and 10 holidays per year.

Skills:
Content Management Systems (CMS), Dosimetry, Medical Assistance, Medical Physics, Nuclear Medicine, Oncology, Physics, Radiation Therapy

jobs.title: Instrumentation and Electrical Technician Intern
jobs.description:
About the role

Join us as an Instrumentation and Electrical Technician Intern for the Summer 2027 term. This entry-level position provides hands-on support to our I&E teams in Tulsa or Oklahoma City. You will gain experience in the midstream energy industry by assisting with the maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of systems that keep our operations running.

What you'll do

• Install, operate, and maintain instrumentation including transmitters, transducers, fire and gas detectors, gas analyzers, and flow computers.

• Perform scheduled testing on ESD and safety interlock systems.

• Support the operation of SCADA systems, remote terminal units, DCS, PLC systems, and analytical equipment.

• Test and maintain operation technology networks and equipment.

• Conduct preventative maintenance and analytical testing on compressors, engines, drivers, and auxiliary equipment.

• Maintain low and medium voltage electrical power circuits, switchgear, and power distribution systems.

• Prepare maintenance logs, safety reports, mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, and loop sheets.

• Participate in job shadowing and assist with team presentations and knowledge sharing.

What you'll need

• High school diploma and at least 18 years of age.

• Current enrollment in a relevant technical or related program is preferred.

• Commitment to safety and environmental responsibility.

• Strong communication and teamwork skills.

• Ability to take initiative and demonstrate a positive attitude.

• Proficiency in basic arithmetic, algebra, or statistical methods.

• Critical thinking skills and attention to detail.

• Willingness to work outdoors in various weather conditions.

• Basic understanding of instrumentation and electrical principles is a plus.

Location & details

• Locations: Tulsa, Oklahoma or Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.

• Term: Summer 2027.

• Status: Full-time internship.

• Work Modality: On-site.

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data Warehouse & BI team and help us expand the reach, depth, and operational impact of our modern data platform. This is a hands-on role focused on report development, model expansion, and the ongoing reliability of a production analytics stack that already drives company-wide reporting.

You will work closely with stakeholders across the business, including operations, finance, dispatch, inventory, vendor management, and others. You need to be an expert at building and maintaining these relationships. They will help give you the context and information needed to deliver reporting and insights that enhances how the business runs.

Our source systems are varied and disparate, with multiple ERPs, each carrying its own schema, conventions, and quirks. If you enjoy untangling messy data and turning it into something trustworthy, then this is the place for you.

  • Respond to ad-hoc data requests that drive business decisions and initiatives
